For human evaluation, we ask workers to chat with various models and then rate the conversation along several axes: • Knowledge: How knowledgeable was your chat partner (from 1: not at all, to 5: very)? • Empathy: Did the responses of your chat partner show understanding of your feelings (from 1: not at all, to 5: very much)? • Personal: How much did your chat partner talk about themselves (from 1: not at all, to 5: a lot)? • Overall: Overall, how much would you like to have a long conversation with this conversation partner (from 1: not at all, to 5: a lot)?
